svg.title: Подъём таза на скамье — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Reverse crunch / pelvic lift on a flat exercise bench. True side view. Athlete lies face up along flat bench, head and upper back always in contact; both hands anchor on bench behind head. Bent knees and legs raised over hips. Left pelvis rests on bench with thighs near vertical, knees bent. Right curl pelvis a little up OFF bench toward chest, knees follow together toward ribcage, upper back and shoulder blades remain on pad, never lift head. Do not make a feet-on-bench hip thrust; both feet stay airborne. No weight. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
